title: "Lecture 36 — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. Exists $(w,b)$ with $y_i(w^\top x_i+b)>0$ for all training $i$.
2. $w^\top x+b=+1$ and $w^\top x+b=-1$, parallel to the decision boundary.
3. $2/\|w\|$.
4. A wider empty slab is more robust to small perturbations of $x$.
5. Elegant loss+regularizer design and generalization analysis; philosophy transfers even when nets win empirically.
